title: Footer links are 20px tall — below the 44px touch minimum
current_behavior: Footer nav links render 20px high (للتجّار 31x20, المتاجر 38x20, الجملة 38x20, الأسعار 44x20, من نحن 44x20). 29-34 sub-44px interactive elements per page.
user_impact: Mis-taps on mobile; users with motor impairment cannot reliably hit links
business_impact: Every page on the platform fails WCAG 2.5.5; footer navigation effectively unusable on phones
recommended_solution: Add vertical padding to the footer link class (e.g. py-2 with -my-2 to preserve visual rhythm). One line, fixes all 127 routes.
evidence: Measured at 390x844 and 1440x900 — identical on every route

title: Seven form inputs on the Sunday Market page have no accessible name
current_behavior: 7 inputs with no aria-label, no <label for>, and not wrapped in a label
user_impact: Screen-reader users cannot tell what the filter controls do
business_impact: Excludes assistive-tech users from a whole section; WCAG 4.1.2 failure
recommended_solution: Wrap each control in the existing <Field> primitive or add aria-label

title: 212 hardcoded Tailwind palette colours bypass the token system
current_behavior: 212 raw palette classes (bg-blue-600, text-emerald-500 …) outside the token layer; concentrated under (dashboard)/
user_impact: Colours do not flip with the dark theme — latent dark-mode contrast defects across merchant surfaces
business_impact: Business OS, the actual differentiator, looks less coherent than the storefront
recommended_solution: Convert to semantic tokens (bg-primary / text-success / bg-surface-muted …) file by file using the offender list

title: Header icon buttons are 36x36 — under the 44px minimum
current_behavior: Icon buttons (menu, theme toggle, bells) measure 36x36; language pills 63x28
recommended_solution: Raise icon-button hit area to 44x44 (visual size can stay 36 via padding)

title: Search input on homepage and explore has no accessible name
current_behavior: 1 input without an accessible name on each
user_impact: Screen-reader users get an unlabelled edit field on the primary discovery control
business_impact: Weakens the most important entry point for assistive-tech users
recommended_solution: Add aria-label to the search input

title: Core UI primitives missing — Table
recommended_solution: ui/ ships 14 primitives; no Table, Toast, Modal/Drawer (only confirm-dialog), Pagination, Switch, Select, Breadcrumb, Chart container
shared_component: Inconsistent behaviour between pages that hand-roll these
affected_file: Root cause of MJ-D03 — absent primitives force ad-hoc markup that carries hardcoded colours
estimated_effort: Build the four highest-value primitives first (Table, Toast, Modal, Pagination), then migrate pages onto them

title: 30 raw hex literals and 22 inline style blocks in TSX
current_behavior: Hex values and inline style objects hardcoded in components
business_impact: Small ongoing drift away from the token layer
recommended_solution: Replace with tokens where they are colours; keep only genuinely dynamic values inline

title: No visual-regression tooling
current_behavior: Vitest only; no Playwright or screenshot baselines
business_impact: Any redesign batch risks silent visual regressions across 127 routes
recommended_solution: Add Playwright with baselines for ~12 key routes x 2 viewports x 2 themes x 2 languages — after Checkpoint 0 approval

title: Dashboard and admin surfaces never runtime-audited
current_behavior: Auth-gated; the iframe harness redirects to login
business_impact: The surfaces carrying the most hardcoded colour are the least verified
recommended_solution: Run the same harness with an authenticated session before the dashboard batch

title: Screenshots unavailable — no human visual-composition review
current_behavior: Browser pane not displayed; page does not composite frames; all screenshot calls timed out
business_impact: Composition, hierarchy and 'does it look good' claims are unverified — only measurable properties were audited
recommended_solution: Re-run with the Browser pane displayed to capture the current-state screenshot set
evidence: Tool error: 'the Browser pane is not displayed'
